title_en: Fall 2026 Master's and Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedules (Subject to Change)
summary: The schedules for the Fall 2026 master's thesis examination public presentations and doctoral preliminary examination public presentations are given in two attached files, which may change at any time. Attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar course, must check the attached files again on the day of the examination, as times and venues may change. Enquiries should go to the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.
applies_to: Anyone attending the Fall 2026 master's thesis examination public presentations or doctoral preliminary examination public presentations, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar course [석박사세미나]. The notice does not state whether attendance is mandatory.

dates.what: Final check of the attached schedule for time and venue changes (for all attendees, including Master's/Doctoral Seminar students). The actual presentation dates are only in the attachments, which were not read.
dates.when: On the day of the examination itself

conditions: The schedules in the attachments may change at any time without separate notice.
Times and venues of presentations may change, so an earlier copy of the schedule may be out of date.
steps: Download and read the two attached files on the original notice: the doctoral preliminary examination schedule [2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf] and the master's examination schedule [2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf]. Their contents were not read for this translation.
Check the attached files again on the day of the examination for any change of time or venue before attending.
Direct any questions to the department office in Building 301, Room 319; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Changes at any time) Fall 2026 Master's/Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule

We announce the schedule for the Fall 2026 master's/doctoral thesis examination public presentations.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- See the attached file (contents may change at any time).

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary examination [초심]) schedule
- See the attached file (contents may change at any time).

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached files) is updated at any time. As times, venues and other details may change, attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar [석박사세미나], must check the attached files again on the day of the examination.

4. Enquiries
- Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's name, phone number and email address are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2):
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 doctoral preliminary examination schedule, 149 KB)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 master's examination schedule, 143 KB)

(The contents of the attached files were not available and were not read.)
